disclaimer: This tool helps families organize care arrangements for children. It does not provide legal advice about custody or guardianship. Families with questions about legal arrangements commonly consult a family law attorney.

checklist.title: Care Planning Checklist
checklist.subtitle: Families commonly find the following helpful to organize.
items: Current caregiver information recorded and up to date
At least two backup caregivers identified
School notified of situation (per family's discretion)
Child's passport and birth certificate located
Medical records and insurance information gathered
Caregiver has written authorization to make decisions on child's behalf (families commonly consult an attorney about authorization documents)

support_letters.info: Support letters are personal statements commonly gathered by families. The relevance of any letter to a specific legal proceeding is a matter for the family's attorney to assess.
